content: Can somebody give me a review or at least some comments on this? Perhaps @Quang Dao, @Eric Wieser, @Tanner Duve..?

Devon has spoken to me about this. I think it is a good consolidation, the fewer new definitions the better for a library like cslib.

The only potential downside is that computation with PFunctor.FreeM may be slower due to more pattern matching. But I don't think that is necessarily the goal anyway

I've only just seen cslib#731; my initial hesitation is that (perhaps modulo universes) every inductive type can be modelled as a W-type, but doing so means giving up various ergonomics and so Mathlib never actual does this.
